title: Disruption/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Transmissions during Disruption missions. Note that CT refers to "control tower".
- Ordis: "Ordis is detecting Sentient waveforms, Operator. Strange interlink. Splattered in Corpus crosstalk. Bypass that console so we might get a better understanding..."
- Alad V: "Oh no! You've caught me! Me and my little partnership! Where's that Lotus when you need her? Now, sniff-sniff, Betrayers. See if you can find the cheese."
- Ordis: "Outgoing communications cipher... Not much of a trick for Ordis, is it? Oh, how scandalous! Alad's system has a back door! Shall we... listen in?"
- Alad V (to CT): "Ah, more test subjects have arrived. Right on schedule. CT, prepare my Amalgams for further... evolution. I've baited the traps."
- Ordis: "These conduits are the source of those Sentient waveforms. This may be worthwhile if we can find the key component... but it does seem a tad convenient, doesn't it?"
- Alad V: "Almost there, you clever vermin! But what to do next? Can you feel that coming rush? That cocktail of unflinching violence and pseudo-random rewards? Mm, good for business."
- Alad V (to CT): "Showtime, CT. Inform our Partners another trial has begun. Prep interference routines. Bait and wait... it's time for Alad V to get back on the corporate map, yes!"
- Alad V: "As a man with everything to lose, I make a point of employing the opposite. Release the Demolyst!"
- Alad V: "In battle, advantage goes to the one most willing to die. And my Demolysts, Tenno? Well, they aren't just willing... they want it."
- Alad V: "Demolyst! Target the Conduit... and claim your glory!"
- Alad V (to CT): "CT... they've accessed a Conduit. [sigh] Deploy a Demolyst!"
- Alad V (to CT): "CT, time for a Demolyst."
- Alad V (to CT): "Conduit activated? CT, send in a Demolyst."
- Alad V (to CT): "They're preoccupied! Now, CT, the Demolyst!"
- Alad V: "Is it just me or is it getting a little warm in here? Zanuka taught me your weaknesses, Betrayers."
- Alad V (to CT): "CT, fire up the data spools and call in reinforcements. These Tenno look at thick as they are bloodthirsty. Selling their personal combat data is going to make me very, very rich."
- Alad V (to CT): "Give the Betrayers a little hope, and we'll sink the hook deeper."
- Alad V (to CT): "Let's flip the program, and see what these Amalgams can do."
- Alad V (to CT): "CT, the model is getting a bit predictable. A little morale boost might be good for conditioning, hm, yes."
- Alad V (to CT): "Let the Betrayers have a little fun while we crunch the numbers."
- Alad V (to CT): "CT, invert the algorithm. Give them a little false hope."
- Alad V (to CT): "What... what if we make the Tenno more of a threat... really see what these Amalgams can do?"
- Alad V: "Betrayers, frustrated yet? Get used to it."
- Alad V: "This week on Nightwave: Tenno lose big, give up on life! Details at the next cycle."
- Alad V: "Don't be discouraged! Failure has made you what you are... a failure."
- Alad V: "Will you try again? Will you give me another reason to laugh?"
- Alad V: "A pity... you could have used that. Hmm, but I'm bad at sharing, you know."
- Alad V (whispering): "I thought you were better than this! You're making me look bad in front of my new business associates."
- Alad V (whispering): "Finally. Some investments take longer to earn out."
- Alad V (to CT): "CT, fast-track these disciples for promotion... I mean, conversion, of course."
- Alad V (whispering): "These disciples finally show some merit. Credit where credit is due: I am an excellent leader. Yes."
- Alad V: "Greedy are we? I admire that Tenno."
- Alad V: "Feeling a bit... out of sorts, Tenno? Noticing any... performance problems with that metal seashell of yours?"
- Alad V: "I've taken my knocks in the past, but, Tenno, you seem a bit sluggish, a bit spent. Are you sure you want to continue?"
- Alad V: "Disciples, remember your vows. Increase profits, and decrease... Tenno!"
- Alad V: "I see. Another round? Good to see my greed wearing off on you!"
- Alad V (to CT): "Relentless, even when they're spinning on the spit. CT, signal the supply decks. We're going to need additional ‘volunteers' for conversion."
- Alad V (to CT): "This has gone far enough. CT, cycle the interference routines. We need to knock these freaks down a notch."
- Alad V (to CT): "Bait followed by battery followed by bait. I'm getting bored. CT, let's salt our interference routines and dispatch the next Amalgams, yes."
- Alad V (to CT): "CT, permute the next interference routines. They had better work this time."
- Alad V (to CT): "I need to cut my losses, quick. CT, dispatch updated interference routines... and, uh... lower the room temperature, could you?"
- Alad V: "Thank you for your generous brutality and violence! My Amalgams have never been better!"
- Alad V: "Take your trinkets. A small price to pay for a superior product."
- Alad V: "Good! Keep it up. Every single bit-stream of this carnage only makes me richer."
- Alad V (whispering): "What did they get? This is spiraling on us. I'm hemorrhaging inventory!"
- Alad V (to CT): "CT, transfer more disciples and begin conversion at once! We're deep in the red now."
- Alad V: "Oh, are you still floating there? Like a twit tetrapod, oblivious to the rising heat."
- Alad V: "Hm, the smart move would be to walk away while you still can. Consequences aren't your strong suit, are they?"
- Alad V: "Ready for more, Betrayers? I have to admire your greed! Sure, let's go again!"
- Alad V (to CT): "Keep the losses on the quiet channel, CT! Sweep this from the records."
- Alad V (whispering): "I don't like this. Inventory as bait was a mistake. What do I do now?"
- Alad V (to CT): "Useless disciples! CT, is it so hard to get good help these days? The sooner they're all Amalgams, the better."
- Alad V (to CT): "Steady... steady now, follow the plan. Trials make data, data is sold, Amalgams evolve... Tenno die. And I won't have to beg for mercy from the Partners."
- Alad V (to CT): "More losses. More debt. How am I going to explain this to that... that thing?"
- Alad V (to CT): "CT, rescan the comm channels. I can't shake the feeling that someone's listening in. The Board? Our Partners? I don't know."
- Ordis: "Some kind of failsafe? If placed in a conduit, it will cancel the running interference routines. Use it wisely, Operator; there's only one!"
- Ordis: "You found a conduit failsafe. This will likely cancel active interference. There's just one, Operator. A real tactical dilemma, isn't it?"
- Alad V (to CT): "What happened to the interference routines? CT, what's going on?"
- Alad V (to CT): "The interference routines have vanished. What's going on up there? CT, we need diagnostics."
- Alad V (to CT): "Failsafe activated? They've trashed the active cycle. CT, sweep the authorization codes... immediately."
- Alad V (to CT): "The data's good, at least. Worth more than a few trinkets to our business partners, yes."
- Alad V (to CT): "CT, integrate this for the next generational cycle. We need to recoup... aggressively."
- Alad V (to CT): "Another weakness revealed and removed. Who knew these violent prongs would be so good at science?"
- Alad V (to CT): "Unfortunately, but this is how evolution works. One generation closer to an Amalgam they just can't kill."
- Alad V (to CT): "This is getting out of hand."
- Alad V (to CT): "Wasteful, but failure teaches faster. Our Partners will be pleased."
- Ordis: "Impressive! Ordis is just fluttering with anticipation! What will the Operator—murder—find next?"
- Ordis: "Scans indicate these conduits are connected to a massive stockpile of resources. Just how long is the Operator planning to fight for?"
- Ordis: "Ordis thinks Alad will miss this."
- Ordis: "May Ordis suggest extraction? Nothing Alad has is worth your life."
- Ordis: "For how much longer will the Operator play along with Alad's twisted game?"
- Ordis: "Ordis knows the Operator has the wisdom to choose comfort and safety over material gain. Ordis... is right, is he not?"
- Ordis: "Operator, the stockpile of tech and resources connected to these conduits seems beyond Alad's means. Where did he get all this?"
- Ordis: "Ordis will add this to the pile."
- Ordis: "Excellent find. Might the Operator now consider returning to the warm embrace of the Orbiter?"
- Alad V: "Is that all you're good for?"
- Alad V: "You could have so much more..."
- Alad V: "We're just getting reacquainted. Don't leave the party just yet!"
- Alad V: "Smell that? Newly evolved Amalgams, fresh from the oven! Want a taste?"
- Alad V: "You're greedy, Tenno, very greedy. It's an inspiration to us all."
- Alad V: "Impressive performance, Betrayer. But, if you don't mind, we're going to change things up."
- Alad V: "Don't leave, Betrayer! Think of all the science we could be doing..."
- Alad V: "Keep testing me, Betrayers. And I'll keep testing you."
- Alad V: "Let's see if that shiny Tenno luck holds."
- Alad V: "Another roll, Betrayers? I think your number's bound to come up."
- Alad V: "So... feeling better, Tenno? I can fix that."
- Alad V: "I told my Partners you were insatiable... but even I'm impressed!"
- Alad V: "We have unfinished business. Shall we?"
- Alad V: "The next Amalgam cycle will show you what it means to be on the bleeding edge."
- Alad V (to CT): "They'll be back. And my Amalgams will be waiting."
- Alad V (to CT): "Costly. CT, send combat results to our Partners, but... omit our losses."
- Alad V (to CT): "It's not an ideal outcome. I just hope it's enough to appease that flying freak [sigh]."
- Alad V: "Thank you, Tenno. By your thick-headed violent demonstration, my new Partner Amalgams are ready for full production!"
- Alad V: "Game over! You lose... but take comfort in what that means: that I win! [laughs]"
- Alad V: "You got greedy, Tenno. Best leave that to a professional."
- Alad V (to CT): "Disciples performing well. Perhaps I should start a profit-sharing program? [snickers] No."
- Alad V (to CT): "This... this is how we do it. CT, prepare the revised Amalgam routines for the next production cycle."
- Alad V (to CT): "That should keep the Partners happy. Or, at least, less... un-happy. [sigh]"
- Alad V (to CT): "Well done disciples. CT, promotions! Fast-track them for amalgamation."
- Alad V: "I told the Partners you were stronger than this. You've made a liar of me."
- Alad V: "Look at all of those shattered Warframes! Zanuka's going to get a new litter!"
- Alad V: "Can't shake that feeling I'm being watched. CT, scan for unauthorized streams again."
- Alad V: "Outgoing Partner frequencies? How long have they've been watching?"
- Alad V (to CT): "CT, have you cut that outgoing signal? If the Corpus Board or the Tenno..."
- Ordis: "Operator, incoming transmission. It's from... Fortuna."

- Little Duck: "Alad V's sellin' the latest in "asset security". Conduits. Put the key in, and ya can pull the shinnies out. Trick is, you gotta wait to open. Somethin' happens to the Conduit before you can pull the goods? You don't get the goods. Ever. Also, the bleeders Alad sold the tech to will try to kill you."
- Little Duck: "This isn't your regular vault job. Alad V sold the Conduits with interference routines, specifically designed for the Tenno. Don't you worry though. I've got some work arounds."
- Little Duck: "This isn't your regular vault job. Alad V sold the Conduits with interference routines, specifically designed for the Tenno. Things might get a little weird."
- Little Duck: "Give that console the ol' bypass so we can get this thing started."

- Little Duck: "Well, looks like the Infested snagged this one. I haven't seen this many zits since puberty. Fortunately for us, the Conduits are still operational. Unfortunately for us; so are the security mechanisms."
- Little Duck: "That there is a Conduit. Useless without the key. Start turning out pockets."
- Little Duck: "Conduit keys are carried by high-ranking muckity-mucks. Knock 'em down, see what they got."
- Little Duck: "First key. Right. Find a matching Conduit."
- Little Duck: "They key worked. Protect the Conduit and watch out for Demo units. They're going try and blow that thing up."
- Little Duck: "Demo unit incoming. Don't let them near the Conduit."
- Little Duck: "Hear that beeping? Demo unit's on its way."
- Little Duck: "Demo unit coming in fast. That thing blows and you can kiss the Conduit goodbye."
- Little Duck: "Demo units lookin' to depart this mortal coil and take you with it. Keep it clear of that Conduit."
- Little Duck: "You're about due for more a those whatsits: Interference routines. Demo units too."
- Little Duck: "Can't do anything about that last interference routine. You'll just have to wear it. Maybe I can catch the next one."
- Little Duck: "Right, they're havin' a go. Keep the demos away from that Conduit."
- Little Duck: "Next verse same as the first. Mind you don't get flanked."
- Little Duck: "More of the old ultraviolence. Keep your back to the objective, old mate. Lock it down 'till she pops."
- Little Duck: "Routine subverted and you're juiced. Nice. Shoulda been a boffin. Missed me callin'."
- Little Duck: "Looks like Alad was so keen to make the sale he didn't close every back door. Greed makes a person sloppy, Hotshot, remember that. Enjoy the boost."
- Little Duck: "Perforrrmaaaancesic]... improvement? Won't be looking that Kubrodon in the mouth..."
- Little Duck: "Fiddlin' with an incoming routine. Howzat feel?"
- Little Duck: "What's this now? A failsafe? Yeah, heard about these. They'll cancel any running interference routines, but there's only one per system. Don't waste it."
- Little Duck: "Conduit failsafe. Put that duck in a console and it will cancel out any active interference routine. This is the only one."
- Little Duck: "Inteference routines wiped. Your timing is impecable."
- Little Duck: "Good choice. That failsafe will make the next few moments bareable."
- Little Duck: "Failsafe in effect. Pay no mind to the interference routine for the next little bit."
- Little Duck: "Conduit destroyed. Won't be seeing those goods again."
- Little Duck: "Conduit down. Look. Mumsie may have raised you believin' winnin' ain't the most important thing, but piece of advice? It is."
- Little Duck: "That mucker got past you and now the conduit's blown. Move on. Move on!"
- Little Duck: "Conduit blown. Mate: this is not how bills get paid."
- Little Duck: "Conduit blown. Find another one."
- Little Duck: "Conduit destroyed. Dust yourself off. There'll be another around here someplace."
- Little Duck: "Hope you're not done. Had to pay Maroo a small fortune in rations for this "tip"."
- Little Duck: "Taking squared away. Right, send again?"
- Little Duck: "Got a few seconds before the system resets. We can take them again. You game?"
- Little Duck: "Care to live up to your reputation and try again?"
- Little Duck: "Not going home yet. Just got here."
- Little Duck: "Why's ol' Alad call you lot Betrayers anyway? Ah, no matter care for another kick at the Conduit?"
- Little Duck: "Alright... it's gettin' a little hairy. One more round, whaddya say?"
- Little Duck: "Conduits about to reset. Feelin' lucky?"
- Little Duck: "The longer we stick around the more likely we'll get our arses handed to us. Still, with great stupidity comes great reward. Whaddya reckon?"
- Little Duck: "Gettin' a little hot. The gloves are comin' off. Got another round in ya?"
- Little Duck: "Wakey. Wakey. Here. We. Go."
- Little Duck: "Right. They're back, and they're well pissed off."
- Little Duck: "Eyes open, sunshine. Here we go."
- Little Duck: "Bulk signal return. Dig in."
- Little Duck: "Safeties off. We kicked a clown car. Here we go."

path: All Conduits Destroyed After Completing One Round
lines: - Little Duck: "Nothing ventured. You want round two? Ping me."
- Little Duck: "All Conduits sealed. I'm pulling you out."
- Little Duck: "You got out while you could. Smart move."
- Little Duck: "Way ahead of you. Time to hit the pub!"
- Little Duck: "Shinnies secured and we're in the wind. I'll send your cut via the usual. Have a good one."
- Little Duck: "We got as much as we're gettin' hotshot. We're a vapor trail."
- Little Duck: "Hotshot? Come on pal, get up. Hotshot?"
- Little Duck: "I've lost the feed. Where are ya?"
- Little Duck: "I'm punching out. Hotshot, if you can hear me make contact at the usual locale. Little Duck out."
- Little Duck: "Sorry kid. It was a bad play."

- Drusus: "Tenno, if there was ever a time to find artifacts to donate to my plight, now would be that time. If I can't pay Parvos Granum soon, I'll lose the Leverian and all the knowledge stored within."

- Drusus: "My friend, without Dante I need an associate to bring me the goods Parvos demands. To convey the gravity of my situation, I've relayed my comms with that Corpus robber baron to your ship Cephalon. I trust you can and will be that associate for me."

- Drusus: "Tenno, if you can hear this, then you will have decided to act as my field associate. I need Entrati artifacts to keep Parvos Granum from taking control of everything I have built. I'm counting on you, Tenno."
- Loid: "Arterial Conduits. Albrecht's interlab transporting storage system for high value goods and materials. If you can get them working, you should be able to find what Drusus needs... and more."
- Loid: "All you need to get into an arterial Conduit is the correct Docket. Ready for a hunt?"

- Loid: "Systems up. You'll need the correct Docket to open an arterial Conduit. Start looking. Also, the Conduits share the same technology that makes Keyglyphs so burdensome. I do regret implementing that now."
- Loid: "You found an arterial Conduit, but you'll need the matching Docket. Eximus may have them. Gruzzlings most definitely will."
- Loid: "The Murmur have captured the Dockets you need. Be aware, the Gruzzlings have a particular appetite for Dockets."
- Loid: "A Docket. Excellent. Look for a Conduit with a matching glyph."
- Loid: "That's it. Protect the Conduit and watch out for enemy Necramechs. They'll blow the whole apparatus up just to keep you out."
- Loid: "Conduit activated. Explosive Necramechs incoming. Stop them."
- Loid: "Docket verified. Protect the Conduit until the transfer arrives."
- Loid: "Conduit online. Let us hope this one has what Drusus needs."
- Loid: "That was it. Conduit warming up for transfer."
- Loid: "Conduit transfer in progress. Stay focused."
- Loid: "Explosive Necramech coming for that Conduit. Put it down."
- Loid: "Security systems responding to your intrusion. Watch out for explosive Necramechs."
- Loid: "Legacy security protocols dictate that the Necramech must now demolish the Conduit. Do not allow that to transpire."
- Loid: "When you hear beeping, you know something explosive is coming your way."
- Loid: "Eyes and ears open. The system thinks you're hostile and will do everything in its power to destroy the Conduit to thwart you."
- Loid: "With a little luck I was able to reverse the Conduit's burden. Can you feel the difference?"
- Loid: "I have managed to invert the polarization of this Conduit's burden. It's working for you now."
- Loid: "Seems I still have limited control of the Conduit's systems. I've converted this Conduit's burden to a blessing."
- Loid: "How're your systems? Feel a boost? You should, I just reversed that burden's effects."
- Loid: "They blew it up! When they do that, you get nothing."
- Loid: "Conduit destroyed. Please focus. That may have held what Drusus needed."
- Loid: "That one got through. Shake it off and get back in the fight."
- Loid: "That Conduit is now defunct. May I remind you that our friend Drusus is counting on you?"
- Loid: "They just took down a Conduit."
- Loid: "They got one. Listen for the beeps."
- Loid: "Is that...? Why yes, it is. A Conduit Failsafe. This will negate any negative forces the Conduit has inflicted on you."
- Loid: "A Conduit Failsafe. An emergency off switch for the Conduit's negative burdens. A fortuitous find."
- Loid: "Conduit burdens wiped. Your timing is impeccable."
- Loid: "That did it. Your Conduit burdens are no more."
- Loid: "Gruzzling detected. That little monster will have a Docket."
- Loid: "Marking a nearby Gruzzling. They always have Dockets. And probably half my library."
- Loid: "A Gruzzling. It'll certainly have a Docket, but it might also have the final chapter to that book I was reading."
- Loid: "Gruzzling nearby. That thieving freak is certain to have a Docket."
- Loid: "A Gruzzling. For whatever reason those little horrors eat Dockets as if they were sugared biscuits."
- Loid: "Oh great. Gruzzling in your area."
- Loid: "A new set of Conduits is opening. Up for another round?"
- Loid: "That's all of them. Stand by for more Conduits."
- Loid: "Catch your breath. New Conduits will be appearing shortly."
- Loid: "You are fighting admirably, so far. Think you can handle another set of Conduits?"
- Loid: "New Conduits coming online momentarily. Steady yourself."
- Loid: "New Conduits active. Time to start looking for Dockets."
- Loid: "New Conduits at the ready. If you can find the right Dockets."
- Loid: "What do you say, Tenno? Once more unto the breach?"
- Loid: "Given the circumstances, you've done very well."
- Loid: "Good work. Come and see me in the Sanctum to exchange what you found."
- Loid: "All done? I'll put the kettle on."
- Loid: "Quite the haul you've got there. Come and see me. I'd like to take some of it off your hands."
- Drusus: "I owe you all my gratitude."
- Drusus: "A true friend of the Leverian you are."
- Parvos Granum: "You get to keep your dusty junk, Drusus, for now."
- Loid: "We lost them all. It's over."
- Loid: "All Conduits destroyed. There's no salvaging this mission."
- Loid: "You've lost this one. Get back to the Sanctum and regroup."
Parvos Granum: "Drusus, you do remember the penalty for late payment, don't you? Forfeiture."
- Drusus: "Mister Granum, I- I assure you we will not come to that. I'll have more artifacts for you very, very soon. My associate will come through for me."
Parvos Granum: "Drusus Leverian. What purpose does your Leverian serve? What does it build? What does it earn? Nothing. A dusty temple for idle history worship."
- Drusus: "How dare you. It's... no such thing! You will get your payment as agreed. My associate will make sure of it."
Drusus: "Mister Granum, sir, I know you are a man of reason, so I ask of you the courtesy of a slight extension on this term's payment. Entrati artifacts are very difficult to come by, and that-"

- Parvos Granum: "Drusus Thelonious Leverian. Do you think me a gullible man? No. I desire precision. So does our contract, which clearly states: the penalty for missed payment is immediate forfeiture."

Parvos Granum: "If you truly desired greatness for the Leverian, you would've made it happen, Drusus. But you haven't. Instead, you idle away the years, content with unfulfilled dreams and comfortable mediocrity. I desire greater things from the Leverian and her archives."
- Drusus: "You will get your payment, mister Granum, and nothing more."

Parvos Granum: "When I take ownership of your museum and all its contents, will you, Drusus Leverian, be included? Make this easy for me and I will make that transition comfortable for you. But if you prolong the inevitable..."
- Drusus: "I- I cannot leave- You... you will be paid, and I will keep the Leverian."
Drusus: "My associate will have your goods imminently, but I must ask: Why do you seek these mementos of Albrecht Entrati?"
- Parvos Granum: "Drusus, you and I are not so different in this regard. I desire knowledge. Any wayward item that crossed his path may offer hidden... insights."
Parvos Granum: "Do you know the problem with glass, Drusus Leverian? It is so very fragile. But you wouldn't know anything about glass, would you, Drusus?"
- Drusus: "As a museum curator, I do know this: When not handled carefully... glass will cut you."
Parvos Granum: "Drusus, this associate of yours seems uniquely resourceful. If they can be convinced to do my bidding, things would become much easier for you."
- Drusus: "Do understand, mister Granum: My associate is a friend performing a favor. To earn my friend's favor, you'd first have to learn compassion and empathy."
Drusus: "Mister Granum. Payment. Promptly. As promised. Now, piss off."
- Parvos Granum: "As you wish. Until the next payment's due."
Parvos Granum: "Is that all, Drusus? Doesn't look like much."

- Drusus: "The goods provided exceed the agreed-upon sum by several times. Something any student of history could tell you. Such is the value of history. In all your years, you've never learned this?"
Parvos Granum: "Yes. I haven't seen something this beautiful since the days before the Old War."
- Drusus: "My, my. Was that an expression of sentimentality, mister Granum? Careful. You might develop an interest in something other than yourself."
Parvos Granum: "Goods received. But I must ask... you wouldn't hold back on me, would you? Your associate hasn't any Warframes, have they?"
- Drusus: "Mister Granum, our deal was for Entrati artifacts. If I did find a Warframe, I assure you, it would not be for sale. And even if it was, you could never afford it."
Drusus: "Mister Granum, my associate is, as always, reliable. Your goods."
- Parvos Granum: "I should hope nothing happens to this associate of yours. For your sake."
Drusus: "Mister Granum. Is this what you desire? You could furnish a hundred Leverians. When will you have enough?"
- Parvos Granum: "When I find the artifact that speaks to me."
